regime_context: For Hong Kong, the detector shows a bifurcated tape: Diversified Miners leads the rotation scoreboard by a wide margin but is NOT trend-gate eligible, while the only eligible leader is Conglomerates & Exchange. Broad leadership is narrow (only 6 of 17 themes eligible), no theme is crowded, and the absolute-trend gate is the sole validated edge — so this is a staying-power/shake-out discipline, not a return forecast.
emerging_watch: Watch whether Diversified Miners regains trend-gate eligibility while Conglomerates & Exchange keeps its top eligible-durability slot — if Miners re-enters the gate with its 2.0+ momentum lead intact, the Conglomerates overweight should be reconsidered. Retire this watch when Miners has stayed ineligible for two consecutive detector prints.

theses.subject: Conglomerates & Exchange
theses.thesis: The highest-ranked trend-gate ELIGIBLE theme, with the strongest durability bar (0.78) among eligible names and no crowding. It is the market's headline theme. Given gate_helps=true, the absolute-trend gate is the one validated edge: staying with the eligible, uncrowded, high-durability leader is a defensible trend-following posture, not a momentum prediction.
evidence: durability_bar 0.78, highest among eligible leadership candidates
theses.dissent: The rotation radar shows the leader is actually Diversified Miners (not eligible) and the Conglomerates theme has a 'mixed' hurst tag — leadership may be unstable. Plus the headline weight (0.25) is low and the theme is unscorable (no proxy), so the call cannot be graded against a listed instrument.

falsifier.text: Conglomerates & Exchange relative strength rolls over and it drops out of the top-3 eligible ranks in the next two weeks

theses.subject: High-Dividend Blue Chips
theses.thesis: Eligible, trending (hurst tag 'trend'), full breadth (1.0), and among the most durable (durability_bar 0.83 — the highest on the whole board). In a narrowing, low-eligibility tape, this is a high-quality defensible trend-following candidate. Gate discipline favours it as a staying-power holding.
theses.dissent: Its momentum score (0.578) lags Conglomerates & Exchange (0.82) and the theme is unscorable, so there is no clean observable to grade. Telecom/utilities income themes in HK can also underperform in a risk-on AI/tech macro backdrop (ai_tech dominates headlines).

falsifier.text: High-Dividend Blue Chips fall below the trend-gate eligibility threshold or its durability bar drops decisively below 0.7

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable

theses.subject: Diversified Miners
theses.thesis: The top momentum score (2.15) and rotation leader, but NOT trend-gate eligible. The one validated edge is the absolute-trend gate — a theme outside the gate is exactly the drawdown/shake-out risk the discipline exists to avoid. Under discipline_not_prediction, an ineligible leader is an 'avoid' on trend-following grounds, not a short.
evidence: hurst_tag trend, breadth 1.0 (strong momentum but no gate pass)
theses.dissent: Momentum leadership is real (title leader, breadth 1.0, trending) and it could re-enter the gate quickly; avoiding it may miss continuation. Also, if the gate is momentarily false but trend health is high, pre-gating may be premature.

falsifier.text: Diversified Miners becomes trend-gate eligible while maintaining its momentum lead

check.reason: theme has no scalar etf_proxy → not cleanly scorable
